reg_deadline.en: Registration closed Saturday, October 10, 2026. For military and overseas voters, it closed Monday, October 19. Not sure you're registered? Look yourself up on iVote, the state's voter portal.
reg_deadline.es: El registro cerró el sábado 10 de octubre de 2026. Para votantes militares y en el extranjero, cerró el lunes 19 de octubre. ¿No sabes si estás registrado? Búscate en iVote, el portal de votantes del estado.
reg_deadline.quote: The deadline to register to vote if you are not yet registered is Saturday, October 10, 2026 . Uniformed service members and citizens living outside the United States who are not yet registered, must register to vote by Monday, October 19, 2026 to vote in the General Election.

mail_request.en: To get your absentee ballot by mail, request it by Friday, October 30, 2026. The fastest way is on iVote. If you qualify, you can also get one at your county Department of Elections office until noon on Monday, November 2.
mail_request.es: Para recibir tu boleta de voto en ausencia por correo, solicítala a más tardar el viernes 30 de octubre de 2026. La forma más rápida es en iVote. Si cumples los requisitos, también puedes obtenerla en la oficina del Departamento de Elecciones de tu condado hasta el mediodía del lunes 2 de noviembre.
mail_request.quote: The last day to submit a request for a General Election absentee ballot in order for the absentee ballot to be mailed is Friday, October 30, 2026 . The deadline for the Department of Elections to issue absentee ballots for the General Election is Monday, November 2, 2026 at noon . ... You can vote at the Department when it is open for Absentee Voting.
mail_request.en_after: Mailed absentee ballot requests closed October 30. If you qualify to vote absentee, your county Department of Elections office can still give you a ballot until noon on Monday, November 2. Or vote at your assigned polling place on Election Day.
mail_request.es_after: Las solicitudes de boleta de voto en ausencia por correo cerraron el 30 de octubre. Si cumples los requisitos para votar en ausencia, la oficina del Departamento de Elecciones de tu condado todavía puede darte una boleta hasta el mediodía del lunes 2 de noviembre. O vota en el lugar de votación que te corresponde el Día de las Elecciones.

mail_return.en: Your county Department of Elections office must receive it by 8 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. A postmark isn't enough. Mail it as soon as you can, or hand it in at your county office.
mail_return.es: La oficina del Departamento de Elecciones de tu condado debe recibirla a más tardar a las 8 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre de 2026. No basta con el matasellos. Envíala lo antes posible o entrégala en la oficina de tu condado.
mail_return.quote: Absentee ballots must be received by the Department of Elections by Election Day, Tuesday, November 3, 2026 by the close of polls at 8 p.m. , in order to count.

early_hours.en: Thursday, October 22 to Saturday, October 24: 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. No early voting on Sunday, October 25. Monday, October 26 and Tuesday, October 27: 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. Wednesday, October 28 to Sunday, November 1: 11 a.m. to 7 p.m.
early_hours.es: Del jueves 22 al sábado 24 de octubre: de 7 a. m. a 7 p. m. No hay votación anticipada el domingo 25 de octubre. Lunes 26 y martes 27 de octubre: de 7 a. m. a 7 p. m. Del miércoles 28 de octubre al domingo 1 de noviembre: de 11 a. m. a 7 p. m.
early_hours.en_after: Through Sunday, November 1, early voting sites are open 11 a.m. to 7 p.m.
early_hours.es_after: Hasta el domingo 1 de noviembre, los centros de votación anticipada abren de 11 a. m. a 7 p. m.

cure.en: Forgot to sign the oath or seal the envelope? You can fix it until the polls close at 8 p.m. on Tuesday, November 3, 2026.
cure.es: ¿Se te olvidó firmar el juramento o cerrar el sobre? Puedes corregirlo hasta que cierren los lugares de votación a las 8 p. m. del martes 3 de noviembre de 2026.
cure.quote: If a returned ballot is cured before the polls close on the day of the election, the ballot must be processed and included in the tabulation.

in_person.en: During early voting, vote at any early voting site in your county. On Election Day, vote at your assigned polling place from 7 a.m. to 8 p.m.
in_person.es: Durante la votación anticipada, vota en cualquier centro de votación anticipada de tu condado. El Día de las Elecciones, vota en el lugar de votación que te corresponde de 7 a. m. a 8 p. m.
in_person.quote: You may vote in person at any Early Voting Site in your county of residence during the 10 day early voting period before Election Day.

locator_label.en: iVote voter portal (Delaware Department of Elections)
locator_label.es: Portal de votantes iVote (Departamento de Elecciones de Delaware)

rule.en: On Election Day, vote at your assigned polling place. Find it on iVote or at de.gov/voteplaces. Sussex County District 36-01: your polling place moved from Lulu Ross Elementary to Mispillion Elementary School, 311 Lovers Lane, Milford, after a fire. Voting early? Use any early voting site in your county.
rule.es: El Día de las Elecciones, vota en el lugar de votación que te corresponde. Búscalo en iVote o en de.gov/voteplaces. Distrito 36-01 del condado de Sussex: tu lugar de votación se mudó de Lulu Ross Elementary a Mispillion Elementary School, 311 Lovers Lane, Milford, después de un incendio. ¿Vas a votar por anticipado? Usa cualquier centro de votación anticipada de tu condado.
rule.quote: the Department of Elections Sussex County Office has relocated the polling place of Sussex County Election District 36-01 voters for the November 3, 2026, General Election to Mispillion Elementary School at 311 Lovers Lane, Milford, Delaware 19963 .

en: A current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck or other government document with your name and address (a copy is fine)
es: Tarjeta de identificación estatal de Delaware
Un recibo de servicios reciente, estado de cuenta bancario, cheque del gobierno, talón de pago u otro documento del gobierno con tu nombre y dirección (sirve una copia)
accepted.quote: You may show one form of ID, which may be a Delaware Driver's License or State ID Card, or a copy of a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck or other government document that shows your name and address.

without.en: Delaware doesn't require a photo ID. Poll workers ask for proof of identity, and showing it speeds up check-in. No ID with you? If you're at your correct polling place or an early voting site and you're on the poll list, you fill out an Affirmation of Voter Identity form and vote.
without.es: Delaware no exige identificación con foto. Los trabajadores electorales piden un comprobante de identidad, y mostrarlo agiliza el registro de entrada. ¿No traes identificación? Si estás en tu lugar de votación correcto o en un centro de votación anticipada y apareces en la lista de votantes, llenas un formulario de afirmación de identidad (Affirmation of Voter Identity) y votas.
without.quote: Delaware does not require a photo ID to vote in State and Federal Elections. Showing ID expedites the voter check-in process. Delaware does not have a defined list of acceptable forms of identification. If a voter does not show ID, is present in their correct polling place or at an early voting site and appears on the poll list, the voter must fill out a form, called an “Affirmation of Voter Identity” and are then permitted to vote

who.en: You can vote absentee in Delaware if you can't get to your polling place on Election Day because you:
who.es: Puedes votar en ausencia en Delaware si no puedes ir a tu lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones porque:
who.quote: Because such person is absent from the district while on vacation; or

en: work in public service for the United States or Delaware, or live outside the country for a while, or are the spouse or dependent living with someone who does
serve in the armed forces or merchant marine, or with the American Red Cross or USO alongside the armed forces
can't get there because of your job, including caring at home for a parent, spouse or child who needs constant care
can't vote at that time or on that day because of your religion
are covered by the federal military and overseas voting law (UOCAVA) or another federal law
es: trabajas en el servicio público de Estados Unidos o de Delaware, o vives fuera del país por un tiempo, o eres cónyuge o dependiente y vives con alguien en esa situación
sirves en las fuerzas armadas o la marina mercante, o con la Cruz Roja Americana o la USO junto a las fuerzas armadas
no puedes ir por tu trabajo, incluido cuidar en casa a tu padre o madre, cónyuge o hijo que necesita cuidado constante
estás enfermo o tienes una discapacidad física
no puedes votar a esa hora o ese día por tu religión
te cubre la ley federal de voto militar y en el extranjero (UOCAVA) u otra ley federal
who_list.quote: Because such person is sick or physically disabled; or

witness.en: Check that your information on the ballot envelope is right, sign the oath on it, and seal it.
witness.es: Revisa que tus datos en el sobre de la boleta estén bien, firma el juramento que viene en el sobre y ciérralo.
witness.quote: The elector shall confirm that the information about that elector on the ballot envelope is correct and then sign the self-administered oath.

cure.en: Forgot to sign the oath or seal the envelope? The Department will try to reach you by phone or email so you can fix it. Fix it before the polls close at 8 p.m. on Election Day and it gets counted.
cure.es: ¿Se te olvidó firmar el juramento o cerrar el sobre? El Departamento intentará comunicarse contigo por teléfono o correo electrónico para que lo corrijas. Si lo corriges antes de que cierren los lugares de votación a las 8 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones, tu boleta se cuenta.
cure.quote: The Department shall attempt to notify the voter by phone or email of the deficiency under subsection (a) of this section and of the action that the voter can take to correct the deficiency.

dropbox.en: Hand it in at your county Department of Elections office during business hours, by 8 p.m. on Election Day: Wilmington (820 N. French St.), Dover (100 Enterprise Pl.) or Georgetown (119 N. Race St.). Early voting sites and polling places can't take absentee ballots.
dropbox.es: Entrégala en la oficina del Departamento de Elecciones de tu condado en horario de oficina, a más tardar a las 8 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones: Wilmington (820 N. French St.), Dover (100 Enterprise Pl.) o Georgetown (119 N. Race St.). Los centros de votación anticipada y los lugares de votación no reciben boletas de voto en ausencia.
dropbox.quote: Absentee ballots are not accepted at early voting sites and polling places. Voted absentee ballots may be hand-delivered to your county Department of Elections office.

gear.en: Leave the campaign buttons and banners at home. Within 50 feet of the entrance to the building where you vote, no one may electioneer, and that includes wearing a button, banner or other item about issues, candidates or partisan topics.
gear.es: Deja en casa los botones y las pancartas de campaña. A menos de 50 pies de la entrada del edificio donde votas nadie puede hacer campaña, y eso incluye llevar un botón, una pancarta u otro objeto sobre propuestas, candidatos o temas partidistas.
gear.quote: “Electioneering” includes political discussion of issues, candidates or partisan topics, the wearing of any button, banner or other object referring to issues, candidates or partisan topics,

phone.en: Don't talk on your cell phone in the polling place. The Department of Elections says the noise interferes with poll workers and distracts voters. We found no Delaware law or Department rule on taking photos inside, so ask a poll worker before you take one.
phone.es: No hables por tu celular en el lugar de votación. El Departamento de Elecciones dice que el ruido interfiere con los trabajadores electorales y distrae a los votantes. No encontramos ninguna ley de Delaware ni regla del Departamento sobre tomar fotos adentro, así que pregúntale a un trabajador electoral antes de tomar una.
phone.quote: Can I talk on my cell phone at the Polling Place? No, because the noise interferes with poll workers and distracts voters.

line.en: Polls close at 8 p.m. If you're in line by then, stay in line. You'll be allowed to vote.
line.es: Los lugares de votación cierran a las 8 p. m. Si estás en la fila a esa hora, quédate en la fila. Te dejarán votar.
line.quote: The election shall be continued open until 8:00 p.m. when it shall be closed.

tradition.notes: No Delaware sticker contest or design found on an official page (rechecked 2026-10-28; the only leads are News Journal and syndicated news items, not official).

provisional.en: If you say you're registered but your name isn't on the list, you can vote a provisional ballot for federal offices only, after signing a statement that you're registered and eligible. It isn't counted if you aren't registered in Delaware. Afterward, enter the number you're given on the Department of Elections' provisional ballot page to see whether it counted, and why if not.
provisional.es: Si dices que estás registrado pero tu nombre no está en la lista, puedes votar con una boleta provisional solo para cargos federales, después de firmar una declaración de que estás registrado y puedes votar. No se cuenta si no estás registrado en Delaware. Después, escribe el número que te den en la página de boletas provisionales del Departamento de Elecciones para ver si se contó y, si no, por qué.
provisional.quote: Individuals who claim to be registered to vote in a federal election in a jurisdiction but are not on the official list of registered voters can cast a provisional ballot for candidates for Federal Offices only. ... By entering a unique number the voter can learn whether or not the ballot was counted and, if not, why?
provisional.notes: Pass 2 Oct 30, read by curl. Not counted if not registered: Delaware Code title 15, ch. 49 (former src). Replaces: If election officers can't confirm you're eligible, you can vote a provisional ballot for the federal offices on the ballot. The Department reviews provisional ballots the day after the election. A provisional ballot isn't counted if its affidavit is incomplete, if you didn't show identification, or if you aren't registered to vote in Delaware.

line.en: You can still vote. Anyone waiting in line by 8 p.m. on Election Day, inside or outside the voting room, is allowed to vote.
line.es: Igual puedes votar. Toda persona que esté en la fila a las 8 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones, dentro o fuera del cuarto de votación, puede votar.
line.quote: provided that at 8:00 p.m. they shall be in a line awaiting their turn to vote within the voting room itself or if the line extends outside of the voting room itself within that line;

track.en: Check your absentee ballot's status on iVote, the state's voter portal, or call the Department of Elections.
track.es: Revisa el estado de tu boleta de voto en ausencia en iVote, el portal de votantes del estado, o llama al Departamento de Elecciones.
track.quote: Check on the status of yours with the State's Voter Portal.

unsigned.en: The Department will try to reach you by phone or email. Sign the oath, or seal the envelope, before the polls close at 8 p.m. on Election Day, and your ballot is processed and counted.
unsigned.es: El Departamento intentará comunicarse contigo por teléfono o correo electrónico. Firma el juramento, o cierra el sobre, antes de que cierren los lugares de votación a las 8 p. m. del Día de las Elecciones, y tu boleta se procesa y se cuenta.
unsigned.quote: If a returned ballot is cured before the polls close on the day of the election, the ballot must be processed and included in the tabulation.

late_mail.en: It has to reach your county office by 8 p.m. on November 3, and a postmark doesn't count. In the last days, take it to your county Department of Elections office.
late_mail.es: Debe llegar a la oficina de tu condado a más tardar a las 8 p. m. del 3 de noviembre, y el matasellos no cuenta. En los últimos días, llévala a la oficina del Departamento de Elecciones de tu condado.
late_mail.quote: You may return your absentee ballot by mail. If mailing your absentee ballot, please mail it as soon as possible to avoid delays.

notes: Read October 21, 2026 on elections.delaware.gov (General Election, Ways to Vote and Voting Locations by curl; the Absentee page in Chrome, because the site's firewall rejected curl and WebFetch after a few requests; the 2026 Election Calendar PDF and the FAQ page were also rejected and not read) and delcode.delaware.gov (Title 15, ch. 49 subch. II: 4937 ID, 4942 electioneering, 4947 closing and line, 4948 provisional; ch. 55: 5502 eligibility, 5507 envelope, 5508 return, 5509A cure). Early voting dates in states.js (October 22 to November 1, no early voting Sunday, October 25) match the Voting Locations page. 'A postmark isn't enough' rests on 5508(b) and the received-by wording; no page says 'postmark' outright. The waystovote page links to a 2024 election calendar PDF; the general page links the 2026 one. Delaware absentee voting needs a reason (5502; the Absentee page says permanent absentee status 'is affirmed by the Delaware Supreme Court'). Provisional ballots under 4948 are for federal offices only. No phone rule, expired-ID rule or sticker tradition found. Oct 28 pass: VotingFAQ.html (photo ID not required, no defined ID list, cell phone rule, provisional), general page (Oct 19 UOCAVA registration, noon Nov 2 absentee issue deadline), 36-01 polling place alert on news.delaware.gov (Oct 26), ch. 49 4948(h) provisional tally rules. No Delaware law or Department rule on photographing a ballot found; 4942 covers electioneering only.

hours.en: Polling places are open 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. local time.
hours.es: Los lugares de votación abren de 7 a. m. a 8 p. m., hora local.
hours.quote: Polling Places are open from 7 a.m. until 8 p.m. on General Election Day, November 3, 2026.
